comparator.name: Musicology (Muziekwetenschap)
comparator.sourceNotes: The retained Cognitive and Computational Musicology allocation is not certified as a coherent 180-EC pathway. The current guide displays 60+60+60 only by listing Musical Celebrities (115221386Y, 6 EC) in both years two and three; distinct credited content, including the published 36-EC free block, totals 174 EC. The public prospective table still shows 3-EC methods and a generic 6-EC second-year choice, while the current guide expands both methods to 6 EC and transition rules replace older project/portfolio requirements. These versions cannot be stacked. The 12-EC thesis requires 150 completed EC. Diagnostic and tutoring formation are zero-credit. English-taught selected courses support NLD+ENG metadata independently of the unresolved allocation.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target names no specialization. The current specific guide retains Cognitive and Computational Musicology as a valid published route; it is kept independently of UCR fit while the route's cohort-specific credit conflict remains unresolved.

exception.reason: The retained Cognitive and Computational Musicology route has a nominal current guide allocation of 60/60/60, but Musical Celebrities (115221386Y, 6 EC) appears in both years two and three: the distinct credited units total only 174. Current 2026 transition rules replace earlier 3-EC methods with 6-EC methods and make Musical Celebrities a replacement for older project/portfolio requirements. The prospective table still shows the older 3-EC methods and generic 6-EC second-year space. These cannot be combined into a certified new-entry 180-EC path. The stored common aggregate conceals membership, and the exception’s 42-EC genuinely open claim conflicts with its stored free 36. Independently, English-taught compulsory/selected courses and omitted zero-credit diagnostic/tutoring formation establish current corrections. The nominal 180-EC display is retained only as a diagnostic; the repeated 6-EC course is not separately earned, so distinct supported credit totals 174 EC.
